title: FLUJO epic 563 contract and evidence ledger

objective.const: All nine original dimensions independently reassessed at A- or better

acceptanceContract.title: Reviewed version 1 acceptance minimums
acceptanceContract.description: Normative policy data consumed by validate-scorecard.mjs for cross-record checks. Change with the schema and ledger contract version under explicit review; proposed targets still require human agreement before measurement.

pilot-users.denominator: All enrolled humans reported; ten independent target users each week, excluding author/bots

novice-success.denominator: Ten novices; provisioning, drop-offs and missing outcomes separately recorded, no favorable replacement
novice-success.window: One attempt per novice, within 15 minutes

novice-time.denominator: All ten attempts from install start; preprovisioning time separately reported

human-contributors.denominator: Unique humans, excluding author and all bots

backup-maintainers.denominator: Named additional humans completing review and disposable release/recovery drills
backup-maintainers.window: After training; observed drills before acceptance

persona-append-p95.denominator: Raw append samples for every one of 28 days, 20 Activities/day, seed 459, learning enabled

persona-peak-rss.denominator: Daily runtime observations on pinned controlled Node 22 runner

persona-rss-growth.denominator: Matched day-1/final observations on same runner

persona-append-flatness.denominator: All daily raw append samples and nearest-rank p95
persona-append-flatness.window: First seven versus last seven simulated days

persona-total-collection.denominator: 2 x 560 generated Activities + 128; all collection kinds included

persona-leases.denominator: All current and legacy Persona lease records

persona-recall-p95.denominator: 50,000 items; 20 searches, with full-candidate and ranking quality checks

pilot-users.denominator: All enrolled humans reported; ten independent target users each week, excluding author/bots

novice-success.denominator: Ten novices; provisioning, drop-offs and missing outcomes separately recorded, no favorable replacement
novice-success.window: One attempt per novice, within 15 minutes

novice-time.denominator: All ten attempts from install start; preprovisioning time separately reported

backup-maintainers.denominator: Named additional humans completing review and disposable release/recovery drills
backup-maintainers.window: After training; observed drills before acceptance

human-contributors.denominator: Unique humans, excluding author and all bots

runtime-peak-rss.denominator: Node 22 controlled 2-CPU/2-GiB Windows/Linux runner, eight mixed lanes with <=four active; >=2 MB parent/<=5.6 MB child transcripts; media separately bounded
runtime-peak-rss.window: 24 elapsed hours; measured admission/refusal plus original #520 reproduction
runtime-peak-rss.basis: #569 resource owner must ratify workload and admission budgets before measurement; not a current guarantee

runtime-rss-growth.denominator: Same #569 workload, first hour baseline after warmup, no cache reset
runtime-rss-growth.basis: #569 proposal; must distinguish GC/allocator high water and retained growth

runtime-concurrency.denominator: Eight queued lanes; refusal/backpressure counts, owned paused states and archive bytes reported
runtime-concurrency.basis: #569 proposal; does not authorize silently reducing configured parallelism

recovery-rto.denominator: Ten injected process kills and ten graceful restarts per claimed OS/install profile; readiness plus admitted/suppressed schedule state, not port-open alone
recovery-rto.basis: #570/#553 owners must ratify; interrupted effects never blindly replay

backup-rpo.denominator: Ten disposable round trips per claimed profile; corruption/unknown-version/foreign-owner negative controls included
backup-rpo.basis: #570/#567 proposal; coherent writer freeze required before capture

duplicate-effects.denominator: All admitted effect IDs across restart/fault trials; unknown outcomes counted separately, never success
duplicate-effects.window: All recovery trials and authorized live runs

unauthorized-access.denominator: Every positive/negative row of session/token/origin/CSRF/account/workspace/process/export/share/revoke matrix; report exact row count, skipped rows block
unauthorized-access.window: One complete release matrix per profile

high-findings.denominator: All independent review findings; severity dispute remains blocker

live-smoke.denominator: All due rounds, admitted Activities, verified effects, failures, unscheduled interventions and spend observations
live-smoke.window: One elapsed hour, before longer live stages
live-smoke.basis: #578 proposal; concrete account/model scope and separately declared enforced monetary envelope remain unset

live-seven-days.denominator: All due rounds and verified effects across restarts; no omitted downtime; >=99% successful due rounds, zero duplicate effects
live-seven-days.basis: #578 proposal; enforceable account/model spend cap and owner authorization required

live-28-days.denominator: All due rounds and verified effects across entire claim; no simulated-time substitution
live-28-days.window: 28 consecutive elapsed days, if multi-week autonomy claimed

live-success-rate.denominator: All due rounds, including missed/stalled/rejected/failed; zero denominator fails; planned faults and unscheduled interventions separate
live-success-rate.basis: #505/#578 proposal; requires useful output-quality assessment, not repeated no-op checks

live-interventions.denominator: All intervention requests/actions after setup; scheduled fault/control actions also reported separately
live-interventions.basis: #505/#578 proposal; human absence cannot be inferred from fixture automation

live-spend.denominator: All provider charges attributable to the declared run/account/model scope, reconciled with enforced accounting. No numeric cap is declared here; the measurement owner records concrete funding and an accounted limit before acceptance measurement. Existing development/deployment authorization remains in force.
live-spend.basis: #578; null records the undeclared numeric acceptance measurement envelope. The owner supplies concrete funding and accounted budget; existing development/deployment authorization remains in force.
